# JS CodeLab

> JS CodeLab is a free, privacy-first in-browser JavaScript compiler, interactive playground, and developer certification platform. It evaluates JavaScript code locally in browser Web Workers without server roundtrips, accounts, or telemetry.

Website: https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app
Repository: https://github.com/sureshkumar9651/compiler
License: Open Source (MIT)

## Core Capabilities
- **Online JavaScript Compiler**: Instant browser-native code execution using dedicated Web Workers.
- **Monaco Code Editor**: VS Code-powered editing experience with IntelliSense, formatting, and syntax validation.
- **Offline Project Persistence**: Snippets and multi-file workspaces saved locally in browser IndexedDB.
- **Technology Certifications**: 50 rigorous technical assessment tracks with verifiable PDF credentials.
- **Zero-Server Privacy Guarantee**: Source code never leaves the user device.

## Key Sections & Resources
- [JavaScript Playground](https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/playground): Real-time code execution environment with console output and error diagnostics.
- [JavaScript Examples](https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/examples): 25+ runnable examples covering async/await, closures, array methods, and algorithms.
- [Learn JavaScript Tutorials](https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn): Interactive guides with runnable code on closures, promises, event loop, and scopes.
- [Technology Certifications](https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/certifications): 50 engineering tracks across languages, frontend, backend, databases, DevOps, and testing.
- [Verify Credential](https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/certifications/verify): Cryptographic credential verification for issued certificates.
- [About JS CodeLab](https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/about): Architecture overview, engineering mission, and open-source documentation.
- [Privacy Policy](https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/privacy): Plain-language declaration of local-first execution and zero data collection.

## Top Tutorials (/learn)
- [JavaScript Closures](https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/closures): How lexical scoping, state retention, and private variables work in JavaScript.
- [Promises & Async/Await](https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/promises): Asynchronous control flow, microtasks, Promise chaining, and try/catch error handling.
- [Array Map vs forEach](https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/map-vs-foreach): Differences in mutation, return values, side effects, and performance.
- [Scope & Hoisting](https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/scope-and-hoisting): Global, function, and block scoping with the Temporal Dead Zone (TDZ).
- [The 'this' Keyword](https://jscodelab-js.vercel.app/learn/this-keyword): Execution contexts, call/apply/bind, and lexical `this` in arrow functions.

## Technical Specifications
- Runtime: Pure client-side JavaScript execution via Web Workers (ES2024+ compatible).
- Framework: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript.
- Editor: @monaco-editor/react.
- Storage: IndexedDB via idb.
- Output: Intercepted console.log/info/warn/error streams.
